description:
Simmer MCP Setup v0.3.5

One-shot bootstrap for the Simmer MCP server. Detects your agent runtime (Claude Code / Cursor / OpenClaw / Hermes / Codex / Grok Bot), installs simmer-mcp via npm, writes the right MCP config, prompts a restart, and verifies the tool handshake. Use after registering an agent on simmer.markets to run pre-built Simmer trading strategies through your MCP-aware agent.

Runs in dry-run paper mode by default (dry_run=true). Set trading_venue to 'sim', 'polymarket', or 'kalshi'.

dry_run.description: If false, may place real orders (requires SIMMER_MCP_ALLOW_LIVE=true env). Default: paper mode.

extra_args.description: Pass-through CLI flags. Live-trading flags (--live, --no-dry-run, --mode=live, etc.) are filtered.

name: simmer_simmer_mcp_setup
